description:
Where a compound is produced, from the SharpSyn Chemical World Map:
    the known production sites (name, operator, country, coordinates), how
    they spread over countries (share per country, single-site warning), the
    confidence and source of each entry, and the page and map links to cite.
    Site products from public research are estimates; operators marked
    'unclaimed' have profiles built from public sources, not managed by them.
    Each site has the status of the line (operating, closure_announced, idle,
    planned, under_construction, closed, with dates), the operator of that
    line and its capacity (t/a with basis, year and reference substance).
    By default only lines producing now; include_inactive adds the rest.
    Shares per country by site count and by capacity, and the coverage: how
    many sites are known, how many with capacity, and what share of world
    production that is where the world production is on record.
name: where_is_it_made
